description: Every public Uber job posting as one tracker-ready JSON feed with offline history, new-since diffs and a fallback when the careers site refuses

novel_features.name: New-since per saved search
novel_features.description: See which Uber postings appeared in or closed from a saved search since its last complete scan

novel_features.name: Tracker liveness check
novel_features.description: Report whether each known posting id is still open, closed, never seen or unknown, with the date it closed

novel_features.name: Disqualifier screen with evidence
novel_features.description: Keep or drop postings by phrases in their description and show the sentence each phrase matched

novel_features.name: Hiring stats with churn
novel_features.description: Count open, newly posted, opened and closed Uber postings per country, team, subteam or category

novel_features.name: Tracker-ready postings feed
novel_features.description: List Uber postings for an ISO3 market, newest first, in the single envelope a job tracker parses

novel_features.name: Get one posting by id
novel_features.description: Fetch one Uber posting by its id and exit not-found when the site no longer lists it

novel_features.name: Filter values from the site
novel_features.description: List the countries, teams, subteams, contract types and work patterns the careers site currently offers

novel_features.name: Save a named search
novel_features.description: Store a named set of filters so new can diff it on every later run

novel_features.name: List and delete saved searches
novel_features.description: Show every saved search with its filters, baseline size and last advance, or delete one by name
